reader_note: llama-index-readers-file missing from the venv (llama-index 0.14.23 meta-package did not install it; pip permission-blocked). Without it SimpleDirectoryReader silently reads PDFs as plain text (raw %PDF bytes) — doc A then crashed nltk punkt with RecursionError (llamaindex-a-defaultcrash.log). Used the documented file_extractor hook with a pypdf-per-page reader identical to the official PDFReader.
